summary.text: Jennifer Rhodes is a Republican state representative from Cheshire District 17 in the New Hampshire House of Representatives, where she has served since December 2022, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as real estate agent.

paragraphs.text: Jennifer Rhodes lives in Winchester, New Hampshire, and her career experience includes working as a real estate agent.
Rhodes assumed office in the New Hampshire House of Representatives on December 7, 2022.
Ballotpedia lists her as clerk of the Criminal Justice and Public Safety Committee in 2021-2022 and vice chair of that committee in 2023-2024.
She advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026, and is on the November 3 ballot for Cheshire 17, where Jennie Gomarlo is also a candidate.
